digest.component_or_area: ticket digest and clarity validation framework
propositions: Six proposed deterministic clarity criteria produce false positives when applied as hard validity gates against 574 historical closed tickets with signed plan-review attestation.
Canonical section requirements (Approach, Scope, exact lexicon markers) reject valid plans whose mechanism is expressed via semantic aliases or non-heading compact structure.
Per-AC explicit proof-coverage markers and conjunction/hedge hygiene rules fail to distinguish precise behavioral oracles from unresolved design choices.
Edit-set grounding rules incorrectly apply to read-only analysis and operational work with explicit no-edit output contracts.
Testing section requirements based on failure/edge/boundary marker presence reject valid work where the taxonomy is mechanically inapplicable or already covered by regression invariants.

Section presence, placeholder detection, per-AC proof markers, conjunction patterns, and testing nomenclature are reliable advisory signals but unsound as hard rejection criteria without semantic applicability gates.
